title: Gold flown to Geneva and gold certificates fund anticommunist covert operations

plain: After the Second World War, between about 1947 and 1949, a large hoard of gold was flown out of Europe on US military transport planes and placed in the International Credit Bank in Geneva, Switzerland. Paper gold certificates were then issued against it and used to pay for secret operations against communism. A researcher named Dan Sheehan tells this on Michels's show in 2025, naming the intelligence chief Allen Dulles as part of it but no source for the account, which would mean a hidden fortune funded covert work outside normal government budgets.
